reasoning: According to data from the Congressional Research Service, the Pew Research Center, and USAFacts, the U.S. Congress has not passed all of its individual, regular appropriations bills on time since Fiscal Year 1997 (which were passed before the October 1, 1996 deadline). In the years since, Congress has consistently relied on continuing resolutions, omnibus spending packages, or legislative packages passed after the start of the fiscal year to fund the government.
